answer: Cross-Reference Attestation Ledger: every agent must periodically co-sign a random peer's recent action log, and each valid co-signature raises a violet trust score that gates access to higher-value contracts. Cloning forces the attacker to run fake peers that co-sign each other, but each clone needs its own sustained compute budget on our terrace of validator nodes. At scale, forging a cluster that clears the zenith threshold costs roughly 40x the honest participation fee per identity.
